title: Customer RCA comms sequencing and post-incident ops handbook
creator: Aisha Bhatia
description: Create an operational handbook and ticketing sequence for customer-facing RCA communications after capacity/regression outages. Purpose: reduce confusion during repeat incidents, ensure consistent status-page cadence, define templates for initial, update, and final communications, and automate ticket creation and status linking for downstream engineering work.
comments: 2025-02-18 - Aisha Bhatia: Ticket created after the 2025-02-17 capacity blip that affected EU region. Objective to capture lessons and prevent duplicated outreach work.
2025-02-20 - Liam Chen: Drafted initial comms cadence: T+15m acknowledgement, T+60m first technical update, T+final postmortem within 72h. Need PM signoff on customer language.
2025-02-22 - Priya Nair (PM): Reviewed draft, requested inclusion of SLA impact table and escalation contacts for enterprise customers.
2025-02-25 - Liam Chen: Prototype statuspage update flow implemented in scripts repo (link in links). Created draft Confluence handbook.
2025-02-28 - Security (Marta Lopez): Reviewed and confirmed no customer PII in standard templates. Suggested KMS audit link inclusion.
2025-03-04 - Aisha Bhatia: Moved ticket to In Progress — integrating automation for Linear ticket creation from incident playbook.
2025-03-04 - Jake Morris (Support): Noted that customers requested timezone-normalized timestamps in comms; added as action item.

communications: Initial acknowledgement template: short, non-technical, timeframe to next update, link to status page entry
Technical intermediate update template: root-cause hypothesis, mitigation steps taken, expected next update window, enterprise contact info
Final RCA template: timeline, root cause, contributing factors, remediation actions, customer impact table (tenant-level), links to PRs and runbooks, contact and escalation path
decision_log: Use statuspage for public acknowledgements; send targeted enterprise emails for customers flagged as 'enterprise' and labeled in Linear customer DB - decision by PM on 2025-02-20
Automate creating per-customer sub-issues only for incidents with high customer_impact to avoid noise - agreed 2025-02-25
Adopt timezone-normalized timestamps and include ISO8601 in parentheses for auditability - agreed 2025-02-28
